name: Baseline: gray + Otsu
why_tried: Simplest thing possible: eggs are usually brighter than their surroundings.

name: Edge based: Canny + close + fill contours
why_tried: Assignment hint: try edge detection first. Egg outline is a clean closed ellipse, so filling closed edge loops should work.

name: HSV: low saturation & high value
why_tried: White eggs are bright and colourless, whereas skin / wood / cloth backgrounds are coloured; gray-only Otsu ignores that.

name: Lab: low chroma & high lightness
why_tried: Lab separates lightness from colour more perceptually uniformly than HSV; may be more robust to lighting.

name: Morphology: open 0.01 + close 0.02 + fill holes
why_tried: Raw thresholds leave speckle and holes from specular highlights / egg-shell spots.

name: Aggressive morphology: open 0.03 + close 0.06
why_tried: Check whether more smoothing keeps helping or starts to distort shapes / merge objects.

name: Min component area 0.01
why_tried: Small false blobs (bright spots in background) hurt precision and instance counts.

name: Sweep saturation threshold scale
why_tried: Otsu is only a heuristic split; scaling it up/down adjusts how much slightly-coloured shell/shadow is included.
